info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Amazon API Gateway 2014 11 13 Detected Secrets API
APIs.io Engineering Platform Search detected secrets

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of rows to return in the response.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The pointer to the first record of the set of paginated results. To view the next response, use the `nextCursor` value for this parameter.

params.name: include
params.description: The additional fields to be included as a part of the request.

params.name: since
params.description: Return only results created since the given time, in [ISO 8601](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6) format. This value cannot be later than the `until` value.

params.name: until
params.description: Return only results created until this given time, in [ISO 8601](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6) format. This value cannot be earlier than the `since` value.

items.docs: Returns all secrets detected by Postman's [Secret Scanner](https://learning.postman.com/docs/administration/secret-scanner/), grouped by workspace. If you pass an empty request body, this endpoint returns all results.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Update detected secret resolution status

items.docs: Updates the resolution status of a secret detected in a workspace.
